title: Wireless Bluetooth Intercom Headset For Cycling Helmets
body_html:
Product information:
Overview:
This cycling helmet intercom headset features a Qualcomm 51-series chip, supports one‑key network setup and multi‑person intercom, and offers a transmission range of up to 2,000 meters. It delivers intelligent noise reduction, stereo music playback, and crystal‑clear calls, with a battery life of up to 33 hours, making it ideal for long‑distance rides.
Specifications:
Chipset: Qualcomm 51 series
Transmission Range: 2,000 meters
Audio: Stereo
Battery Life: 33 hours
Key Features: Supports Bluetooth, multi‑person intercom, intelligent noise reduction, music sharing, and Bluetooth calling
Wearing Style: Ear‑hook design
Available Colors: Blue, Gray, Red
Material: Plastic
Charging Port: Type‑C


Packing list:
Headphones + Charging Cable + Instruction Manual * 1
